item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ Squishmallows Are Back in Stock, With 4 Fan-Favorite Characters in Plushie Form
item.description:
Here's a short and engaging podcast script based on the article:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Hey there, fans of KPop Demon Hunters! Are you ready to get your hands on some exclusive merchandise? We've got some exciting news for you. The popular animated series has just launched a new Squishmallows collection, and it's already flying off the shelves!"
[Short music transition]
Host: "Jazwares, the company behind the collection, has introduced four fan-favorite characters in plush form: Rumi, Jinu, Sussie, and Derpy. These adorable Squishmallows are made with the brand's signature ultrasoft fabric and feature intricate details that capture the essence of each character."
[Short sound effects]
Host: "Rumi, the human-demon hybrid, is a standout in the collection, with her embroidered mismatched eyes and woven purple braid. Jinu's traditional Korean gat is also a highlight, while Sussie's compact size makes it perfect for display. And let's not forget Derpy, the magical blue tiger, with its signature striped tail."
[Short music transition]
Host: "The Squishmallows sold out within a week of their release online, but don't worry, they're back in stock now. You can get your hands on these cute plushies for between $14.99 and $15.99 on Amazon and Gamestop. Trust us, you won't want to miss out on this opportunity to add these adorable characters to your KPop Demon Hunters collection."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "So, what are you waiting for? Head on over to Amazon or Gamestop and get your KPop Demon Hunters Squishmallows today! And don't forget to tune in next time for more updates on your favorite shows and merchandise."
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
